location: SIT@Punggol Coast, Level 2 Server Room Corridor
description: A major water leak from the ceiling air-conditioning duct is dripping directly onto the top of an active network routing cabinet, causing intermittent Wi-Fi drops across the floor.
risk_summary:
• Water dripping directly onto active network equipment from ceiling AC duct.
• High risk of electrical short circuit, equipment damage, or electrical fire hazard.
• Immediate operational impact causing intermittent Wi-Fi disruption for 15 users.
contextual_insights: Water contact with energized electrical/IT assets creates an immediate risk of short circuits, equipment destruction, and potential electrical fires. Urgent intervention is needed to protect both the IT infrastructure and personnel from electrical hazards, alongside repairing the HVAC condensation or leak issue.

description: The heavy ceiling-mounted projector is visibly tilting to one side and shaking violently during lectures, risking a sudden fall onto students below.
risk_summary:
• Immediate physical strike and crush hazard from compromised overhead fixture.
• Critical failure risk of the ceiling mount exacerbated by ongoing violent vibrations.
• Direct threat to life and physical safety of up to 80 occupants in Lecture Theatre 1.
contextual_insights: With an impact headcount of 80 individuals, a heavy ceiling-mounted projector falling from height poses an immediate risk of fatal or severe blunt force trauma. Lecture Theatre 1 should be immediately evacuated and cordoned off until facilities engineers securely de-mount the hardware and inspect the structural integrity of the ceiling anchoring.

location: SIT@Punggol Coast, Level 2 Electrical Room Corridor
description: The plastic casing of the wall power socket is completely cracked open, leaving live internal copper wires exposed near a damp floor area.
risk_summary:
• Severe risk of electrocution due to exposed live copper conductors.
• Heightened electrocution hazard created by the nearby damp floor increasing electrical conductivity.
• Potential short-circuit and electrical fire hazard in a public corridor.
contextual_insights: Exposed live wiring near moisture presents an immediate life-safety hazard to nearby individuals and maintenance staff. Water significantly lowers electrical resistance, dramatically increasing the likelihood and severity of electric shock or arcing. The power circuit serving this socket/cable must be isolated immediately at the distribution board, and the area should be cordoned off until repairs are completed by certified electrical personnel.

description: The hot water dispenser is dripping continuously onto the tiled floor, creating a small slippery puddle near the collection tray.
risk_summary:
- Potential hazard reported requiring facility inspection
- Standard operational risk mitigation needed
contextual_insights: Standard facility review recommended to ensure campus safety compliance.

description: One of the wooden study chairs has a slightly squeaky leg when sat on, but it is structurally stable and safe to use.
risk_summary:
- Slight auditory distraction due to a squeaky chair leg.
- No structural instability or immediate fall risk present.
contextual_insights: The report indicates that the wooden study chair remains structurally sound and safe to use. The issue is limited to minor acoustic disturbance affecting a single user, presenting minimal safety concern. Regular facility maintenance can lubricate or tighten the joint during routine inspections.
